author: Daniel Kraus
name: bovender's darktable presets
description: Three presets by Daniel Kraus (bovender), heavily inspired by Boris Hajdukovic's (s7habo) darktable tutorials on YouTube: 'inverted linear boris', a tone equalizer preset with an inverted-linear curve; 'mist', a diffuse or sharpen preset for a soft misty rendering; and 'neutral gray sRGB Boris', a sigmoid preset for a neutral tone mapping.
